payload.title: poc.py's UI wire (drift_wire.load_wire) still falls back to the ambient dist/graphql/supergraph.graphql with no freshness check when no --supergraph is given, so a seeder run without the flag can mint HIGH ui_option_drift findings from a stale artifact, while the new graphql class refuses exactly that.
evidence: tools/aria-poc/drift_wire.py:200-205 (path = supergraph or repo_root / SUPERGRAPH_REL, accepted if the file exists, no age or commit check)
tools/aria-poc/seed_drift_findings.py:141-163 (run_fresh_scan passes --supergraph to poc.py only when a path was given)
tools/aria-poc/seed_drift_findings.py:106-112 (the graphql class judges only a supergraph the caller gives, for the stated reason that the ambient file has unknown age)
.github/workflows/aria-auto-cycle.yml:673 (the flag is omitted when ARIA_SUPERGRAPH is unset)
tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_seed_graphql_operation_drift.py:434-476 (the ambient-artifact pin covers the graphql class only)
payload.rule_violated: One policy for which supergraph is trusted: the same seeder run reads the ambient artifact for the UI wire and refuses it for the graphql class.
payload.notes: In a checkout whose dist/ holds an earlier compose (the package measured a 2026-08-27 artifact on this host), a manual seeder run without --supergraph loads it as the UI wire and mints ui_value_not_on_wire HIGH findings against a schema the gateway no longer serves. The nightly lane is protected only because git clean removes dist/ and because ARIA_SUPERGRAPH is set when the artifact fetch succeeds; no test pins the wire default. Close condition: Make load_wire accept only a path the caller gives and return the named result supergraph_not_given otherwise (an explicit flag may keep the CLI default), and add a seeder test that puts a stale artifact at the default path, a UI option drift in the tree, and asserts that no ui_option_drift is minted and a named wire_unverifiable line is printed. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 5). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
